existing_descriptor.notes: Curated at genus level because the preprint reports Bacillus sp. G3.

occurrences.source_assessment: The preprint identifies Bacillus sp. G3 as one of five distinct stocks, with no species resolution supplied here.
occurrences.population_scope: The genus mapping is a 4981/8737 reference majority across 44 GTDB genera, not an exact G3 genome or unanimity.
occurrences.name_scope: Preserve G3, genus-only resolution and uncertainty; do not transfer reference-genome functions or persistence to the experimental stock.

existing_descriptor.notes: Curated at genus level because the preprint reports Bacillus sp. G12.

occurrences.source_assessment: G12 is a separate source-named Bacillus sp. stock, not an alias for G3 despite their identical genus descriptors.
occurrences.population_scope: The same 4981/8737 reference population supports a genus correspondence, not shared genome identity between G12 and G3.
occurrences.name_scope: Retain both stock entries independently; no species selection, assembly match or reciprocal-benefit claim.
